 4 hours ago Trey Nyoni starts Liverpool’s Premier League clash with Arsenal this afternoon.
 By James Carroll
 Previous Next The 19-year-old is handed a place in the Reds XI at Anfield as Andoni Iraola makes seven changes from the midweek Carabao Cup win over Chelsea.
 Victor Munoz and Dominik Szoboszlai return to the squad following injury and are named on the bench.
 Liverpool: Alisson, Van Dijk, Jacquet, Kerkez, Wirtz, Isak, Mac Allister, Gakpo, Barcola, Araujo, Nyoni.
 Subs: Mamardashvili, Gomez, Endo, Szoboszlai, Tsimikas, Munoz, Gravenberch, Koumas, Ngumoha.
